Commentary.Commentary: Right then! 133 to win for Australia. The target is not a massive one but the wicket is on the slower side. With 3 spinners in the Indian bowling attack, they will fancy their chances with the ball. Also, we have seen the teams crumble chasing similar targets and we saw that in the recently concluded tri-series involving India, Australia and England. Stay tuned to see how the run chase pans out.

Australia did not start well with the ball as teenager Shafali pummeled them early on. However, once Jonassen broke the opening stand, they made a comeback in the game. Jonassen along with Kimmince tightened the screws and didn't allow the Indians to score briskly. The duo ended up with 4 wickets between them, giving away 48 runs in 8 overs. Perry was the other bowler who got into the wickets column.

After being asked to bat, Verma and Mandhana started well with Shafali taking the charge. She was very harsh on Perry and Schutt in their first over and provided India a breezy start. But wickets in consecutive overs saw India slow down with Jonassen and Perry taking wickets. Rodrigues and Sharma then took the onus upon themselves to bail India out. They added 53 runs between them to take India towards a respectable total.

An unbeaten 49-run inning from Deepti Sharma means that India have managed to put a decent total on the board. She would've loved to find the ropes on a few occasions but it is a well-composed knock from her because when she came to bat, India were pegged back in the innings.

Just a single on the final ball of the over. A length ball on middle, Krishnamurthy looks to hoick it over long on but mistimes it. It lands over mid on and goes to the long on fielder for a single. INDIA FINISH WITH 132/4.
Full and around middle, Sharma sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Slower one around off, Krishnamurthy looks to punch but the ball hits the bottom part and hits the body. It rolls towards the off side and the batters take off for a single. There is a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Krishnamurthy is in.
Another short ball outside off, Sharma pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A couple now! Short and around middle, Sharma pulls it to deep mid-wicket and returns for a couple.
Length ball outside off, forced to long on for a single.
Delissa Kimmince to bowl the final over of the innings.
Dot to end the over! Full and around off, Sharma can only push it towards cover. Just 4 from the over.
Full and on off, Krishnamurthy drives it to long on for a single.
Misfield and a run! Full and around off, Sharma comes down the track and drives but Jonassen dives to her right to make a half-stop. It goes away to her right and they take the single.
Full and on off, pushed towards long on for a run.

Floated down the leg side, Krishnamurthy looks to pull but mistimes it towards short fine leg. Deepti wants the run but Krishnamurthy shows no interest. Deepti has to quickly return as the throw comes at the non-striker's end. Deepti ducks in order to get out of the way of the throw. The throw from the fielder misses the stumps at the non-striker's end. Had the fielder hit, Deepti would have been out by a mile.
Full and on middle, Deepti whips it to long on for a run.
Very full ball on middle, Sharma pushes it to long on for a single.
Full and on middle, Deepti gets down and sweeps it between deep mid-wicket and long on. Before the fielder can get to the ball, two taken.
Full and on middle, forced to long for a single.
Full and on the pads, Krishnamurthy looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. They appeal but not out says the umpire.
Full and on the pads, Sharma flicks it nicely but it is straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder so just a run.
Shortish and around middle, forced towards mid off for a single.
Just a run off the Free Hit. A full ball on middle, Veda comes down the track and looks to loft but the ball takes the inner half of her bat and goes to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball on middle, Deepti flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. The TV umpire on air informs that Jonassen has overstepped so it is a NO BALL. Jess needs to re-bowl. Free Hit time.
Flatter and on middle, Veda strokes it to long on for a single.
Another fuller ball on middle, it is swept to deep square leg for a single. This time they have protection in the deep.

FOUR! Another boundary! Deepti is playing a very handy innings here. Jonassen bowls another full ball down the leg side, Sharma once again goes for the sweep and connects it sweetly. It races away to the deep square leg fence quickly.
Down the leg side again. Deepti looks to pull but the ball takes a thin inside edge and rolls towards fine leg past Healy. A couple before the short fine leg fielder can get to the ball.
FOUR! Swept away! Timely boundary for the Indians. Full and on middle, Deepti gets in position and sweeps it to the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Veda Krishnamurthy is the new batter in. Jess Jonassen also comes back into the attack to pile on the pressure. Her figures so far, 2-0-5-2.

OUT! LBW! This time Rodrigues cannot be saved by the DRS as she is hit plumb in front of the stumps. Fuller ball from Kimmince, it is on middle and leg, Rodrigues tries to flick but misses. She is hit flush on the pads. The bowler appeals and the umpire raises her finger. After a chat with her partner, Rodrigues goes for the review. The replays roll in. First, Ultra Edge, it shows no bat. Ball Tracker comes in now, it is pitched in line and is hitting the middle pole. Rodrigues has to depart.
Review time! Rodrigues has been adjudged LBW but she has opted to challenge the umpire's decision. It looks plumb to the naked eye. Replays roll in and yes, she is a goner.
100 up for India. A full ball on middle, Sharma sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On the pads, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Quick run! Shortish and around off, Deepti looks to punch but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to short fine leg. They go for the run and complete it easily in the end.
Full and on middle, Rodrigues strokes it down to long on for a single. The single brings up the 50-run stand between the two. Very vital stand this one.
Kimmince starts with a slower bouncer on middle, Deepti pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Delissa Kimmince is back into the attack. 12 runs off her 2 overs but no wickets yet.
Another easy single. Full and outside off, Deepti pushes it towards the off side for a single.
Fuller and on middle, Rodrigues comes forward and works it towards deep mid-wicket for an easy run.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards covers for a run.
On middle, flicked towards long on for a single.
Full and on middle, Deepti pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a run. There is a fumble in the deep and she thinks for an extra run. However, Rodrigues says no so Deepti has to return.
Full ball on middle, Rodrigues strokes it to long on for a single.
This time on the pads of Rodrigues, she works this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
On the pads of Deepti, she works this one towards square leg and takes a single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, pushed down towards long on for a single.
On a good length around off, Sharma punches this one off the back foot towards cover for a single.

Wide! Stumping opportunity missed! Deepti Sharma looks to come down the track but Schutt spots it and pushes the ball down the leg side. Sharma misses her flick and the ball goes towards the keeper. Healy fails to collect the ball though and Deepti survives. A lucky break for the Indian batter. Can she capitalise?
Good length ball on middle and off, pushed down to long on for one.
Schutt bowls one on the pads, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Megan Schutt is back into the attack. 2-0-22-0 are her figures so far.
On the pads of Deepti now, she flicks this one towards square leg and takes a single to keep strike for the next over.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side. One run added to the total.
Shortish delivery on off this time, Deepti rocks back and punches this one towards cover for a single.
Floated delivery on the off pole line, Rodrigues smashes this back towards the bowler. It hits her and goes behind and that allows the batters to steal a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Deepti pushes this one towards cover and bags a run.
Floated on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.

Short and around off, Deepti pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and scampers back for the second. The fielder from the deep fires the throw at the non-striker's end but Rodrigues makes her ground with a dive.
Full and on middle, Rodrigues eases a single down to long on.
Floated around off, Sharma pushes it towards point where the fielder fumbles and allows a run.
Shortish and on middle, Sharma pulls but finds mid-wicket.
Landed on middle, pushed towards covers by Deepti.
Fuller and on middle, Rodrigues pushes it towards long on for a run.
WIDE! Kimmince bowls this one down the leg side. Rodrigues tries to flick but misses.
On the pads of Rodrigues, she flicks this one towards square leg and takes a single to retain strike for the next over.
Full ball on middle, swept towards the leg side but straight to the fielder.
Full ball on middle and off, pushed down to mid on for a single.

FOUR! Good effort in the deep but still a boundary. Good length ball on middle and leg, Sharma goes down on one knee and plays the sweep shot. The ball races towards the mid-wicket region. Haynes from square leg runs across to her right and dives but the ball is half-stopped and sneaks underneath her. It just about touches the fence and a boundary results.
Down the leg side, Deepti looks to work this one towards the leg side but is hit on the pads.
Gardner bowls one on the pads of Rodrigues, she flicks this one towards the leg side for a single.
Ashleigh Gardner is into the attack now.
Another one on the pads of Rodrigues, worked towards the leg side and the batters take one.
Full ball down the leg side for Deepti, she flicks this one towards square leg and takes one. Rodrigues wants the second but she is sent back in time.
Another full ball on the pads, Rodrigues goes down on one knee and paddles it behind square on the leg side. The ball goes to the deep but the batters take just one.
On the pads this time, Rodrigues flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a couple.
A bit shorter in length this time, Deepti goes back and pulls this one towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball outside off to start by Kimmince, Sharma plays this one towards cover.
Delissa Kimmince to bowl now.
Around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for one more.
Full and around off, punched down to long on for one more.
Outside off, punched through the covers for another single.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
Landed outside off, placed through cover-point for a quick single.
Megan Schutt returns. 1-0-16-0 from her so far.
Tight single. Around off, worked through mid-wicket for a quick run.
Down the leg side, helped towards fine leg for a single. 50 UP FOR INDIA.
Around off, tapped straight to point.
Full on middle and leg, pushed towards the off side.
Around middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
Full and around off, flicked through mid on but short mid-wicket dives to her right and stops it.
Full and on middle, Deepti eases it to long on for a run to get off the mark.
WIDE! This time she sprays on the pads, Sharma looks to sweep but fails to make a connection. Wided by the umpire.
On the pads, worked towards mid-wicket.
Deepti Sharma walks in next.

OUT! STUMPED! Jonassen has two and it is the mighty wicket of the Indian skipper Kaur. Australia are making a statement here. Jonassen bowls this loopy ball on middle and leg, Kaur skips down the track and looks to slog it over long on but she misses. The ball just about misses the leg pole and goes behind. Healy fails to collect but the ball hits her pads and ricochets onto the stumps. After a decent start, the Indians have been pegged back in this game.
On middle, Kaur blunts it onto the pitch off his back foot.
Floated on middle, Rodrigues chips it over the bowler for a single down to long off.
Jess bowls a flighted ball outside off, Rodrigues pushes it towards mid off.
Beaten! Length ball just around off, Kaur looks to push it towards the off side but fails to put bat on ball. End of the Powerplay and India are 46/2.
Nicely flicked! Full and on the pads of Kaur, she flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a brace.
Full and on off, Kaur pushes it towards mid off.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, Kaur misses her flick.
Harmanpreet Kaur walks in next, at number 4, replacing Shafali.

OUT! CAUGHT! Australia get their second wicket in as many overs. A short ball, around off, Shafali backs away and pulls it wide of mid on. Or so, she thinks. Because Annabel Sutherland quickly gets across to her right from mid on and takes a clean catch. Verma stands over there in disappointment. She thought she found the gap. So did we. Both the openers dismissed in quick succession then.
On the pads, Rodrigues tucks it towards the mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Going way down the leg side. Jemimah stays. A length ball down the leg side, Rodrigues looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Perry appeals and the umpire raises her finger. Jemimah opts for the review straightaway. The replays roll in and show that there is no bat. The Ball Tracker arrives and confirms why Rodrigues went for the DRS straightaway. It is going down leg so Rodrigues survives.

Jemimah Rodrigues has been given out LBW! She goes for the review straightaway. That looked to be going down the leg side. Let's see what the replays show. No bat there. Here comes the Ball Tracker, missing the stump by some distance.
Ellyse Perry is back on! 1-0-9-0 from her so far.
Full and on middle, Rodrigues drives it to long on for a single to get off the mark. End of a successful over for Australia.

LBW appeal but it is turned down. Probably going down leg. Jonassen bowls a full ball on the pads, Rodrigues looks to sweep but fails to connect. She is hit on the pads and Jonassen puts in a loud appeal. Not out says the umpire.
Flatter and around off, this time Rodrigues pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, Rodrigues tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Shortish slower ball around off, Rodrigues pushes it towards covers.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks in at no. 3.

OUT! LBW! Jonassen strikes and Australia get the breakthrough. She bowls a flighted ball on middle, Mandhana once again gets in position to sweep but is early in the shot. She gets hit on the pads in front of the stumps. Aussies go up in appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The Aussies celebrate.
WIDE! Jonassen starts with a one down the leg side. Smriit looks to sweep but fails to connect. Wided by the umpire.
Jess Jonassen is into the attack now.
FOUR! Superb way to end the over for the Indians. A poor ball from Schutt though. She sprays on the pads and Verma helps it to the fine leg fence.
Beaten! Length ball outside off, Verma looks to force it towards the off side but misses.
FOUR! WOW! What a shot from Shafali. Class written all over it. A length ball just outside off, Verma leans into the drive and crisps it past the diving cover fielder.
Shortish and around off, this time Verma mistimes it towards the bowler.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Schutt bowls a length ball outside off, Verma rocks back and cuts it past the diving point fielder. She finds the gap to perfection and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Schutt gets a harsh welcome from Shafali. This is brilliant batting from her. Megan bowls a full ball outside off, Verma slams it over the mid off fielder for another boundary.
Megan Schutt to bowl now.
Full and on middle, Verma forces it to long on for a run. 13 from the over, a really good one for the Indians.

SIX! Up and over! Shafali verma is making a statement here. Strano bowls a loopy ball in the slot of the right-hander. Verma gets right under the ball and hammers it over long off for a biggie. Top, top shot from the teenager.
Loopy ball on middle, Smriti comes down the track and looks to loft it over mid off again but the ball hits the lower part of her bat and goes to long on for a single.
Full and on middle, this time Verma flicks it to long on and gets off strike.
FOUR! Shafali gets in the action now! She bags her first boundary. Strano bowls a full ball outside off, Verma makes room and smashes it over extra cover for a boundary.
Full ball on middle, Verma pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! The extra ball becomes costly for the Aussies. Perry bowls a fuller and around off delivery for Mandhana, she gets under it and lofts it over the mid off fielder. Once it goes over, it races to the fence. 9 from the second over.
WIDE! Perry tries to stay away from the hitting zone now but ends up bowling way wide. Mandhana lets it be and is been wided by the umpire.
FOUR! She times this one really well and bags the first boundary of the tournament. Short and just outside off, Mandhana gets in position and slams it over mid on for a boundary.
Bowls it wide outside off, Mandhana chases after it fails to connect.
Fuller and outside off, Smriti drives it towards mid off.

Dropped! Strano puts down a chance. Shortish and around off, Mandhana rocks back and goes for the pull but does not time it well. It goes towards Strano at mid-wicket who dives to her left, gets both hands but fails to hold on. Can be a really costly miss.
Perry starts with a short ball outside off, Mandhana fails to cut as the ball hits the bottom part of her willow.
Pace from the other end as Ellyse Perry will bowl from the other end.
Fuller and around off, it is squeezed towards covers. Just two from the first over.
Bowls this slower through the air and just around off, Mandhana waits and guides it towards short third man and calls for a quick run.
Quicker one on middle, this time Smriti forces it towards covers.
Floated ball outside off, Mandhana moves and drives it well but straight to the mid off fielder.
India and Verma are off the mark. A full ball on middle, Verma eases it towards long on for a quick run.
Strano starts with a shortish ball outside off, Verma goes back and tries to punch but the ball hits the top part and rolls towards the off side.

The Aussie players get in a huddle to get a final word of advice from skipper Meg Lanning before they take their positions on the field. The two Indian openers, Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma, the teenager, walk out in the middle to open the innings. Molly Strano will start the proceedings for the Australians with the ball first up. Here we go...
Players from both the side stride out to the middle for their respective national anthems before the action.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Veda Krishnamurthy, Shikha Pandey, Taniya Bhatia (WK), Arundhati Reddy, Poonam Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Ashleigh Gardner, Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry, Rachael Haynes, Annabel Sutherland, Jess Jonassen, Delissa Kimmince, Molly Strano, Megan Schutt.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the Indian skipper says, that she too wanted to bowl first but tells that toss is not in their hands so they will try to play good cricket. Says that they are playing three spinners. On the support back home, the Indian skipper says that she is getting quite a lot of support from the fans back home.

Meg Lanning, the Australian skipper says, that she is not too sure about the conditions. States that weather is one of the reasons for them opting to field. Says that she is really excited for the tournament. Tells that Molly Strano is in the playing XI.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of Australia. THEY WILL BOWL FIRST.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. The hosts, the reigning champions, Australia are taking on India in the tournament opener. Both the sides are termed favourites to win the championship. The first game is always the one where both the sides are normally nervous as they try to pick their best possible XI for the showpiece event. Let's see what teams both the side field in this one. Australians were thumped a blow as Tayla Vlaeminck got ruled out of the tournament due to an injury and Molly Strano has replaced her in the squad. It will be interesting to see if the Aussies bring her in the playing XI straightaway. Both the sides faced off in the recently concluded tri-series final where Australia edged India over. However, this is a World Cup game and the nerves will be different altogether here. Let's hope we get an exciting first game of this T20 World Cup.
